meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Not a general site tour (/website-to-video). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或脚本快速转为宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需为新产品或功能快速制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create a promotional video for a new product or feature

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的产品链接、脚本或简介，自动规划并生成一个产品发布或推广视频。它会一步步完成从素材收集、设计、脚本到最终渲染的全流程。
howto.when: 当你想要推广、发布或介绍一个产品，并给出产品链接、脚本或简介时触发。也适用于任何商业网址的默认处理。

say.text: 根据这段脚本，生成一个产品发布视频。
say.note: Claude 会使用你提供的脚本作为旁白来制作视频。

say.text: 为我们的新功能做个宣传视频，时长30秒。
say.note: Claude 会按指定时长规划视频内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can turn a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch or promo video. It orchestrates the full workflow: capture assets, design system, storyboard, script, audio, visual design, frame building, and final render.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, and you provide a product URL, script, or brief. Also the default for any commercial URL.

say_en.text: Make a promo video for this product: https://example.com/product
say_en.note: Claude will crawl the URL and start the video creation process.

say_en.text: Generate a product launch video from this script.
say_en.note: Claude will use your script as narration for the video.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second feature reveal video for our new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will plan the video with the specified duration.
